brands.name: dUFEU Surfboards
brands.short_description: dUFEU Surfboards in Fforestfach, Swansea — performance, easyrider, and longboard models from the official shop.

models.name: EQUALIZER
models.description:
HI-PERFORMANCE SHORTBOARD - INFLATED dims.
The Equalizer is aimed towards surfers looking for a fraction more foam in their Shortboard.
This board features the same Performance 3 staged rockerline as our Ultrabox Flagship board.
It has fraction more width at the half way mark, we’ve lowered the entry rocker a fraction & slightly increased the centre volume.
Still with a low rail profile, this board feels light under foot , naturally turns in & out of the pocket- leaning towards a more user friendly Hi-Performance Shortboard.
Ability- intermediate to advanced
Supa-lite construction
Available 5’11-6’5
ABILITY- Intermediate - Advanced

models.name: THE HERITAGE
models.description:
EASYRIDER- PERFORMANCE HYBRID
The Heritage is all about more waves, more flow!
Packed with hidden volume, expect sensitivity & performance designed for all wave types.
With Wide point at centre, The Heritage is a familiar user-friendly shape that will keep you turning & going fast every session no matter what the conditions.
Advanced riders can ride it short, Intermediate riders at normal length.
ABILITY: Low intermediate to Advanced
Stock Sizing 5’6 - 6’6
Ride as a thruster when waves are punchy and Twin + Stab in weaker conditions.

models.name: ASTRO TWIN
models.description:
EASYRIDER - MODERN FISH-FUNFORMANCE TWIN FIN.
The ASTRO is a volumised board with tapered, relatively thin down rails for added manoeuvrability & response.
 Medium to low rocker ,the Astro paddles well and gets UP & GO SPEED quickly.
Twin fins give a ‘loose” or ‘slidey’ feel which is great for creative turns & cutbacks.
This TWIN FIN excels in less than perfect conditions and PERFORMS well in a wide range of wave types.
IDEAL WAVE - Anything from 1-5ft (knee high to overhead surf)
Supa-lite or regular construction
Available 5’2-6’4

RIDE 2-4 inches shorter than your normal size OR at your usual length.
ABILITY: Low Intermediate- Advanced

models.name: ULTRABOX YOUTH
models.description:
HI-PERFORMANCE SHORTBOARD in Youth size.
We’ve been developing this golden board for quite a few years, working with some of the UK’s most talented.
Scaled down version of our flagship board- The Ultrabox in Youth dims.
Expect SPEED, CONTROL, Quick rail to rail with adjusted proportions on volumes & rockerline giving the hold & release of a regular size Shortboard.
Ultrabox Youth has been developed around competitive- level Surfing
Supa-lite construction
Available 4’8-5’7
ABILITY - Advanced

models.name: INFUSION
models.description:
STEP-DOWN SHORTBOARD
INFUSION - ULTRABOX Series
Built & designed for hi-performance surfing in soft, weaker waves.
Part of the UB Series we’ve developed an infusion of performance and altered its features to make this board ride fast yet familiar in weaker conditions.
Same foam distribution as the ultrabox with a fraction more thickness throughout.
Relaxed entry rocker is key for flow in small or weaker waves.
The slightly fuller outline with a round tail to shorten the rail line gives a smooth transition through turns, hacks n airs with a ton of release.
Deep single to double concaves to increase lift through the hull.
Medium low rails for quick smooth slices.
Ride: 1” - 2” shorter than normal
Available 5’6-6’0
ABILITY- Intermediate - Advanced

models.name: ULTRABOX
models.description:
FLAGSHIP SHORTBOARD
EXPECT Lively & Responsive - BUILT for fast, critical surfing
ULTRABOX Features a 3 Staged rocker line. Single concave under front foot into a double concave through the fins to increase manoeuvrability & control.
 Hidden foam placement in the deck rolled into to a low rail for manoeuvrability and QUICK RESPONSE.
The ULTRABOX is best in 2-6ft or waist high to overhead.
This board has a long standing history, working closely with our elite riders, over the years the UltraBox has repeatedly proven itself globally making it a good all-rounder.
Available as SQUASH,SWALLOW & ROUND tail.
Supa-lite construction
Available 5’8-6’3
ABILITY : Advanced

models.name: REDUX
models.description:
PERFORMANCE GROVELLER - Built for generating speed in weak everyday waves.
REDUX Features low entry rocker in the front part of the board into accelerated rocker through the tail.
Single concave runs through the hull, blending into deep double concaves through the fin area creating LIFT & RESPONSE.
We’ve kept some hidden volume through the middle section of the board & given a LOW slight down RAIL that allows for HIGH SPEED TURNS.
The Wing to swallow tail leans towards a reactive skatey feel through the back end.
ENGINEERED FOR SPEED- Redux is a great all round board for a wide range of conditions from 1-4 feet (Knee to head high)
Available with 3 or 5 fin boxes.
Ride as Thruster ,Twin plus trailer or quad fin.
Ride: 1” - 4” shorter than normal
Supa-lite construction
Available 5’2-6’4
ABILITY: Intermediate - Advanced

models.name: KONEKILLA STEP-UP
models.description:
Step~driver shortboard for heavier waves.
Featuring a medium rocker line, subtle concaves - hidden volume with tapered rails.
Reinforced construction- these boards are generally built stronger to take the impact on heavy waves & wipeouts. A fraction heavier is an advantage to the swing weight and speed ( even the leash plugs are reinforced!)
The wide point is placed a fraction forward , this provides extra foam under the chest and creates a longer, straighter back half to give reliable response and CONTROL in heavier waves/barrels.
WAVE 4-8ft plus
ABILITY- Advanced
Typical sizes 6’2 - 7’2

models.name: MIDLENGTH
models.description:
Fun & easy to ride, MIDLENGTH likes carves and speed & can be ridden pretty much in everything.
The EXTRA length gives this board natural glide making it EASY to PADDLE & CATCH WAVES.
Mid to Low RAILS & Extended Concave-Vee Hull keeps this board feeling LIGHT and RESPONSIVE through turns.
WAVE 2-6ft or Waist high to well overhead
Available 6’0-7’6
RIDE AS Twin plus trailer, Twin, Quad or Single fin with side bites.
ABILITY: Low Intermediate - Advanced

models.name: TURBOSLUGZ
models.description:
EASYRIDER EGG for Entry level surfing to anyone wanting an easy ride & a ton of waves!
TURBOSLUGZ- Voluminous egg shaped surfboard with relaxed rocker & Thruster fin set up. The TSLUG fully geared up for smooth turns & cutbacks. Great in small waves & will still get you in nice & early when the waves are bigger.
Expect easy padding and stability.
Very fun board for daily conditions, perfect for BEGINNERS right through to anyone who wants an easy ride.
A Fun all rounder.
Size from 6’6 to 7’6

models.name: PRO LOG
models.description:
User friendly high performance Longboard.
Does pretty much everything you could want , nose riding , cutbacks & turns.
Nimble outline, performance rails and 3 fins allows for quicker turning.
PRO-LOG feels light under foot & can be ridden in a variety of conditions from knee high to over head.
Single fin with side bite fins

models.name: LOG
models.description:
Daily Longboard- Ease & flow.
Low entry rocker fits together with the shape of the hull. CONCAVE in the top third for nose riding , blended into a ROLLED VEE HULL and flip out the tail.
Rolled Vee helps this board to tip onto the forgiving 50/50 rails and turn EFFORTLESSLY.
The Single Fin STEER’S the board with the FLOW of the wave.
Paddles like a dream- EXPECT to catch alot of waves!
Choice of vibrant resin tint colour options are available.
WAVE: Best in PEELING waves 1-2ft (Knee to waist high)
ABILITY: Low intermediate to Advanced
Available 8’6-9’6
